result.Method of Attack: Multi-stage layered payload dropper delivering various final-stage malware including RATs and info stealers; Obfuscated payload extraction and reflective loading of DLLs in memory; Delivered via phishing emails with ISO attachments to evade detection; Use of obfuscation tools like DeepSea and SmartAssembly to hinder reverse engineering; Reflective loading of payloads to avoid writing to disk; Final payloads include Leonem (Zusy Banking Trojan), AgentTesla, Lokibot, Remcos, Warzone RAT, Taskun, Trojan Mamut, Androm, Upatre, Sabsik
result.Attack Vector: Phishing emails delivering ISO files containing the dropper executable; Mark-of-the-web (MOTW) bypass via ISO packaging; Multi-stage DLL reflective loading in memory
Indicators of Compromise: SHA1: b6914b8fa3d0b67eb6173123652b7f0682cd24fb (ALco.exe variant with Lokibot payload)
